target: Roadside providers ready to operationalize AI roadside intake, SMS GPS capture, dispatch workflows, fleet notifications, and emergency call routing.

workflows.name: Roadcall Standard - New Lead Speed to Lead
actions: Create or update contact with roadcall and roadcall:plan-standard tags.
Create an opportunity in Roadcall Revenue Pipeline - Standard at New Lead.
Send immediate intro SMS and email with demo CTA.
Create a sales task if no demo is booked after 15 minutes.
Stop when demo_booked, checkout_completed, or subscription_started arrives.

workflows.name: Roadcall Standard - Missed Call Recovery
actions: Add roadcall:missed-call and roadcall:ai-receptionist tags.
Create recovery opportunity at Missed Call.
Send short recovery SMS with opt-out language.
Create urgent task due in 5 minutes.
Move to Recovered only after human or Roadcall confirmation.

workflows.name: Roadcall Professional - Demo Booked Confirmation
actions: Move opportunity to Demo Booked.
Send email and SMS confirmation.
Send 24-hour and 1-hour reminders.
Create follow-up task after demo if subscription_started is missing.

workflows.name: Roadcall Professional - Customer Onboarding
actions: Move opportunity to Customer Active.
Create onboarding opportunity.
Send kickoff and setup checklist messages.
Create internal onboarding task.
Escalate incomplete setup after 3 days.

workflows.name: Roadcall Professional - Review Request
actions: Wait 2 hours after completed job.
Send review SMS and email when consent exists.
Send one reminder after 2 days if no review is recorded.

workflows.name: Roadcall Premium - Roadside Intake Notify
actions: Append CRM note with driver city/state, problem type, and vehicle type.
Add roadcall:dispatch-event tag.
Notify internal ops owner.
Do not select providers, quote prices, promise ETA, or change Roadcall service status.

workflows.name: Roadcall Premium - Successful Transfer Notify
actions: Add success note to contact timeline.
Move dispatch opportunity to Successful Transfer.
Notify fleet contact if configured.
Do not handle billing or provider matching in GHL.

workflows.name: Roadcall Premium - Emergency Escalation
actions: If urgent roadside keywords are present, create immediate human task.
Notify ops owner.
Send short acknowledgement SMS when consent exists.
Route caller to Roadcall roadside intake or human dispatcher.

aiReceptionist.purpose: Answer calls, qualify leads, summarize conversations, collect callback details, and route urgent roadside calls to Roadcall intake or a human.
guardrails: Do not quote final repair costs.
Do not collect full card details.
